_comment: Deployment Rules for DeployPipeline — configure in the Fabric portal: Pipeline → Production stage → Deployment rules gear. Rules can't be imported from a file; this is the reference for what to enter. They are set once and re-apply on every deploy (manual or GitHub Actions).
_promotion_model: Deploy ALL supported items in a SINGLE pass so the Deployment Pipeline pairs them by name and rewrites internal references (including PL_Refresh_Master's activity GUIDs) to the paired Prod items. The three rules below cover the bindings that do NOT auto-rebind, so Prod has no orphaned GUIDs or datasource names.
_recommended_alternative: Prefer the Variable Library (variable_library/VL_CICD_Bindings.json) for the notebook and dataflow bindings — IDs resolve at runtime from the active per-stage value set, so nothing carries a Dev GUID into Prod. Only the Gold_SM data-source rule below is still required (DirectLake can't consume a Variable Library). The notebook and dataflow rules here are the rules-only equivalent if you skip the Variable Library.
_report_note: Gold_Dashboard is a PBIR report. PBIR reports are NOT supported by deployment pipelines, so the report is delivered to Prod via Git (connect ws-CICD-Prod to the repo and Update). Its definition.pbir references Gold_SM byPath, so it binds to the Prod semantic model by name.

rules.description: REQUIRED — DirectLake semantic models do not auto-bind. Binds the model to the stage's Gold_LH SQL endpoint.
REQUIRED — Dataflow Gen2 connections do not auto-bind. Inject the target-stage Silver_LH IDs (Text parameters) so source/destination repoint automatically.

Deterministic override of notebook default-lakehouse auto-binding. Map each notebook's Dev default lakehouse to its matching Prod lakehouse. Code uses three-part names (name-based); without this rule, auto-bind handles it when lakehouses deploy together.

_howto: 1. Build ALL items in Dev, then assign workspaces and Deploy once so every supported item auto-pairs (lakehouses, notebooks, data pipeline, dataflow, semantic model).
2. On the Production stage, click the Deployment rules gear.
5. NB_01/NB_02/NB_03 -> Default lakehouse -> matching Prod lakehouse (deterministic).
6. PL_Refresh_Master needs no rule — its activity GUIDs are re-paired automatically.
7. Gold_Dashboard (PBIR) is not deployed by the pipeline — connect ws-CICD-Prod to Git and Update to deliver it.
8. Rules are stored on the pipeline and applied on every deploy, including GitHub Actions deploys.
